messages:
nora: noticing a burst of schema rejects on function invokes in eu-west. Lots of traffic slipping to degen and we're hitting 429s.
infra-bot: alert: https://ops/alerts/INVOKE-SCHEMA-1765432101 :rotating_light: 720 events / 10m
ben: can you paste an example payload?
nora: redacted sample from trace:
```
{"fn_call": {"name": "list_users", "result": [{"id":"u1"}]} }
```
Schema expects `result` to be an object `{ users: [...] }` not an array. pluralization/field rename.
ria: this was on the strict canary slice (10%). Strict -> reject -> route_to degen -> degen consumes quota. But billing still tags cost to the original route.
billing-bot: current billing tags: [route_tag, customer_id]. routed_to not emitted.
ben: quick fix: emit `exec_worker` tag with final routed_to value in request envelope so billing can join on execution. Low-risk patch.
nora: UX needs: console filter `rejected_by:schema`, show sample diffs, and a small "suggested coercion" snippet (opt-in).
ria: rollout policy: switch canary to soft-fail for 15m while we patch billing and collect samples. Also sample 1% of rejects (schema_reject_sample) with redaction, retention 7d.
ben: agree on thresholds for auto-pause: >5% of slice traffic OR >500 rejects in 10m -> auto-pause canary and page owners.
ria: long-term: build a safe-coercions library with confidence score; auto-coerce only when confidence >0.95 and customer opts in. Console should show diff + apply button.
infra-bot: scheduled deploy window: 30m. Remember to include billing tag migration.
ben: I'll open a PR for exec_worker tag now, aim to land in the 30m window.
nora: toggling canary to soft-fail for 15m and posting Grafana links in #eng-platform after. Reopen if noise continues. :thumbsup:
